purpose: Engineering tokenizer API audit only. Frozen cases/donors/learning data unchanged; no model outcomes inspected for selection. Raw token ID equality determines affected cases and episodes.

verified_loader.code:
from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerFast
tok = PreTrainedTokenizerFast.from_pretrained(local_model_path, local_files_only=True)
verified_loader.main_runtime_policy: Qwen3 retains AutoTokenizer (all audited IDs identical). Qwen3.5 uses PreTrainedTokenizerFast to preserve official tokenizer.json. Do not relax equal-length or frozen-count assertions.
verified_loader.scope: Exact raw IDs for all 708 actual text components per model, including explicit EOS append where runtime does so. This is input-equivalence verification; it does not claim equality for arbitrary unseen Unicode strings.

raw_evidence.format: gzip JSON containing full text corpus and complete raw ID arrays for old AutoTokenizer/new AutoTokenizer/new generic official tokenizer loader

Original affected completed result archived by root; rerun unchanged frozen case under restored original tokenizer IDs.

archive_ownership: Root completed archive and resumed runtime. Result inventory is fixed to tokenizer-amendment.json pre-amendment hashes, so newly regenerated results are not misclassified as superseded.

root_cause.mechanism: Transformers 5.17 AutoTokenizer dispatches tokenizer_class Qwen2Tokenizer to a backend constructor that rebuilds the pretokenizer using generic Qwen2 PRETOKENIZE_REGEX. The official Qwen3.5 tokenizer.json regex groups Unicode combining marks (\p{M}) with letters, while generic Qwen2 omits them. New generic PreTrainedTokenizerFast preserves the tokenizer.json backend and recovers every old ID.
root_cause.special_tokens: Default, add_special_tokens=False and True yield equal prefix counts. All 708 default-vs-False component counts match in all three runs. EOS ids preserved; score targets are compared including the runtime-appended EOS.
root_cause.other_backend_metadata_differences: The new AutoTokenizer also reconstructs some ByteLevel offset/decoder metadata and special_tokens_map presentation. This report establishes exact input ID equality for all preserved results, not a general decoder equivalence claim.

corpus_runtime_scope: The 708-component corpus covers tokenization calls in execution revisions 1 and 2. Revision 3 separately changes learning prompt construction from joint string encoding to concatenated separately encoded prompt/suffix IDs; that construction audit is recorded in learning-token-boundary-audit.json. This tokenizer API audit does not assert joint and segmented construction are equivalent.
later_independent_engineering_amendment: learning-boundary-amendment.json: all four Qwen3 learning episodes rerun for token-boundary alignment, independent of the tokenizer API mismatch diagnosed here.
